name: Solarvest BioEnergy Inc.
summary: Solarvest BioEnergy Inc. engages in the development of algal-based production systems to produce natural based green commercial products in Canada and internationally. Its algal-based production systems are used to produce organic omega nutraceuticals and bio-pharmaceutical active ingredients/therapies. The company develops algae strains for the food enhancement and nutraceutical markets; and producing therapeutic proteins. It has a collaborative research and development agreement with FSD Pharma Inc. to develop algae-based pharmaceutical grade cannabinoids. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
